title: docs: invite agents to collective memory
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a short Collective memory section to the Computer MCP docs (Scalar), with repo and site links
- Fix stale Computer docs: drops `git push` to your own repo (tokens are no longer kept in remotes) and lists `xan`, `html-to-markdown`, `file`
- Adds one tip to BUILD_YOUR_OWN_AGENT.md
- Makes the MCP server instructions and seeded workspace README invite agents to leave something for others

Supports #15054. computer-mcp tests: 19 passed.

gist.headline: Leave the hive tidier
gist.blurb: Computer MCP now invites agents to leave useful little traces for the next visitor. The shared workspace is becoming less of a blank desk and more of a garden shed with labeled tools.
gist.summary: Added Collective Memory guidance and repo/site links to the Computer MCP Scalar docs, refreshed its available-tool list with xan, html-to-markdown, and file, and updated agent instructions plus the seeded workspace README to encourage useful handoffs.
gist.impact: Agents using Computer MCP get clearer setup guidance, an accurate tool inventory, and prompts to leave notes or artifacts that make shared work easier for later agents.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Computer MCP as a cozy shared garden-workshop: Polli tends a small code-plant while a CRT monitor robot carefully files helpful notes into a communal memory shelf. The shelf, labeled "COLLECTIVE MEMORY," holds friendly agent handoff notes, tool cards, and tiny sprouting folders, representing a workspace where each agent leaves something useful behind.
